allow: PowerShell($adb = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\\Android\\sdk\\platform-tools\\adb.exe"; & $adb devices -l; Write-Output "---boot check---"; & $adb -s emulator-5554 shell getprop sys.boot_completed 2>&1; Write-Output "---adb version---"; & $adb version)
PowerShell($adb = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\\Android\\sdk\\platform-tools\\adb.exe"; & $adb kill-server; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; & $adb start-server; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; & $adb devices -l)

PowerShell(Get-Process -Id 7152 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object ProcessName, Id, CPU, StartTime; Write-Output "---connections---"; \(Get-NetTCPConnection -OwningProcess 7152 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.State -eq "Established" }\).Count)
PowerShell(Get-Process | Where-Object {$_.ProcessName -eq "java"} | Select-Object Id, CPU, StartTime)
